title: Sibol MLBB hopes to turn golden expectations into reality in Asiad debut
summary: The expectations are high for Sibol’s Mobile Legends: Bang Bang squad, which enters the Asian Games Aichi-Nagoya 2026 esports tournament as the top favorite to win the gold in the title.
